summary_md: **Lubomir Vesely ([@LubomirVesely1](https://x.com/LubomirVesely1/status/2116164693085897141))** runs the 763B **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash** (vision, 262K context) at about 38 tok/s on 2019 hardware (Threadripper 3960X, DDR4, RTX 5090 + 3080 Ti) via the Strata rig; the key fix was recording each layer as a CUDA graph to replace ~1,000 tiny kernel launches per token, verified byte-identical ([hap911/Strata-Windows-Rig](https://github.com/hap911/Strata-Windows-Rig)).
